items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Sam Allen had an arrangement on 'Three Little Words' -- the piano player. I didn't have any solos like that, because the band just I guess was primarily entertaining.

ctx.x: Even if you've got a lot of different tempos.
